shots.focal_element: Seated employee with black bob and glasses, framed over a glossy desk edge, speaking off-screen
shots.what_happens: Static medium close-up in a letterboxed office set; the employee delivers the deadpan reply 'Sure, if personal minions were pumped about...' (w111-w117) while colleagues sit out of focus behind her.
shots.build_rebuild: Use a 2.39:1 letterboxed live-action medium close-up on a long lens (shallow depth of field, foreground desk blurred) held static for about 3 s under the dialogue line.

shots.focal_element: The seated employee and the standing manager in a burgundy blazer, small in a wide open-plan office
shots.what_happens: Locked-off wide establishing shot of the green-desked open-plan office as the line ends '...resolving data errors.' (w118-w120); the two characters sit left of centre with deep ceiling-grid perspective.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a 1.5 s static wide shot of the full office from a low central camera so the ceiling lights converge, keeping both characters small at left of centre to reset geography.

shots.focal_element: Standing manager reacting sceptically, with the seated employee in the left foreground
shots.what_happens: Over-the-shoulder two-shot: the manager asks 'Are they?' (w121-w122) and the employee turns back to answer 'They are.' (w123-w124); the last contact-sheet frame (0:42.500) already shows the wide office angle of s021, so the actual cut appears to land slightly before the detected boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Frame a static two-shot with the seated character soft in the left foreground and the standing character sharp on the right third, holding about 2.8 s for a two-line question-and-answer exchange.

shots.shot_type_other: live-action wide footage with a composited UI card overlay
shots.focal_element: Frosted-glass 'Steps taken by AI Agents' card floating over the right half of the office wide shot
on_screen_text: Verified status and credentials in active directory.
Checked permissions and resolved any restrictions.
Would you like to reinstate access to the HR portal?
shots.typography: Geometric sans-serif (low-confidence guess: a Gilroy/Poppins-like face); semibold sentence-case header with a sparkle icon on a solid header band; regular-weight sentence-case bullet list at small size with normal tracking; small pill button label in semibold.
shots.what_happens: Over the same wide office shot, a translucent card scales/fades in at right (~0:43.5), its header resolves to 'Steps taken by AI Agents', and bullet lines type on one at a time while the employee says 'You hear that? That's the agent summarizing your case and asking me to approve their work.' (w125-w140); a final question bullet and an 'Approve' pill button appear by ~0:46.0.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a rounded frosted-glass card (backdrop blur, green header band with sparkle icon) on the right half of the footage, fade-scale it in, then typewriter each bullet sequentially about 0.7 s apart and pop in a green 'Approve' pill last, timed to the spoken 'approve' (w138).

shots.focal_element: Standing manager delivering a wistful line beside the smiling seated employee
shots.what_happens: Return to the two-shot angle of s020: the manager says 'I wish HR had fancy AI agents.' (w141-w147) while the employee smiles knowingly, setting up the reveal that follows.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the s020 two-shot setup for a static 2.5 s reaction beat, keeping the seated character's smile visible in the left foreground while the standing character speaks.
